core_obligations: The authors obtain a structured k-simple set from near closure under a dense rank-one tensor multiset. The core combines Fourier localization with a dimension-independent recursive system construction, matrix rank arguments, intersection control and induction across tensor coordinates. The complete core is retained, with original epsilon(d,theta) and k(d,delta) dependence and multiset conventions.
